patina.options.unavailable: This feature is not yet available in Patina.
patina.options.far_terrain.tooltip: Coarse distant terrain beyond the render distance, in local worlds.
patina.options.far_detail.tooltip: Reduced draws far terrain coarser, for GPUs it slows down.
patina.options.resolution_scale.tooltip: World pixels per screen pixel. Below 100% is faster.
patina.options.antialiasing.tooltip: Smooths jagged edges. FXAA is softer, TAA smoothest: moving things may trail.
patina.options.hdr.tooltip: Lava, fire and sunlight shine brighter than white. Needs an HDR display.
patina.options.hdr_black_level.tooltip: Your display's darkest black. 0 for OLED; LCDs glow a little.
patina.options.hdr_peak.tooltip: How bright highlights get. Auto: the peak your system reports.
patina.options.hdr_paper_white.tooltip: How bright white paper and menus look. Auto: your desktop's white.
patina.options.hdr_ui_brightness.tooltip: How bright the HUD and menus are, against paper white.
patina.options.battery_mode.tooltip: 60 FPS cap (30 in menus or unfocused), half the workers: less power.
patina.options.graphics_api.tooltip: Vulkan, then OpenGL or DirectX 12 where it fails. Applies at the next start.
patina.options.fps_overlay.tooltip: Frame rate and frame times over the game.
patina.shader_packs.empty: No shader packs: put them in the shaderpacks folder
patina.client.title: Patina Client
patina.client.editor_hint: Drag to move; wheel or corner to resize
